eld.text: The Wilds is the darker region beyond the Realm where Oko abducts the High King and turns him into a stag, and where the royal twins set out at eighteen to find their father.
Oko and Garruk rescue the twins from redcaps in the Wilds, and Oko transforms Elowen into an eagle and traps the party in a thorn ring, though Rowan realizes the stag is her father.
Cerise removes the hedron from Garruk, freeing his will but unleashing the Chain Veil's curse, until Will's persistence summons the Cauldron of Eternity, which lifts it.
At the Wild Hunt a figure looking like Queen Ayara mortally wounds the stag, who is revealed to be Oko in disguise before he planeswalks away, and the dying stag transforms back into Algenus Kenrith.
